Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
The action to burn Pentex Subversion is listed as a (D) action.
Who is it directed at (i.e., who can block?)

The Methuselah who played PS in the first place?

Another example of the directed against oneself (unblockable,
and in opposition to the definition of directed)?
